comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper opening limit; PR-1896 reads tire pressure through a Schrader valve with a pencil gauge and returns the gauge to its holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric two-tool torque coordination; PR-1896 requires square axial gauge seating, controlled valve-core depression, a timed seal, and replacement of the gauge.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained angular setting over three cycles; PR-1896 requires a sealed 1.5-second press, a 33–37 psi stick reading, upright holder placement, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Pressure-gauge sealing and reading do not test locking an adjustable stop against fastening reaction or post-lock articulated repeatability; no material rubric details are missing.
